speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To help pinpoint the cause, have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatitis B infection.

The patient's 2-month history of fatigue and severe pruritus, combined with abnormal liver function tests, sexual activity with multiple partners, and a history of ulcerative colitis (which increases the risk of Hepatitis B due to potential liver involvement and medication use), strongly suggests an infectious etiology. I will now proceed to confirm this with specific serological tests.

REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), Hepatitis B core antibody (anti-HBc), and Hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg).
REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel (ALT, AST, Bilirubin, Alkaline Phosphatase).
REQUEST TEST: Complete blood count (CBC).
REQUEST TEST: HIV antibody test.
REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis C antibody test.
REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound of the abdomen (to assess liver structure and rule out other causes).
